title: my phone won't open tiktok until i walk 200 steps
format: Caption-on-photo confession story; every slide after the hook is the app doing its weird thing
why: Built to make people ask 'what app?'. The 52 listicles show the app as a fix on one slide, which reads as an ad, and got zero installs. Here the strange mechanic (apps sleep, 200 steps to wake them, a raccoon judges you) is the hook itself, told as a confession, with real app screens on 3 of 7 slides (Erly shape: forced moment, physical act, app gives in). The name only appears as a throwaway last line plus a pinned comment, so the post still feels native.
caption: the raccoon is honestly the worst part. would you make it to 200? #screentime #phoneaddiction #morningroutine #sleep
check: PIN this comment right after posting: it's Locturne on the App Store 🌙 (nocturne with an L)
reply to every 'what app' comment, ideally with a video reply of you walking the 200 steps
slide 7 '12 mornings in a row': change the number to your real count (render shows 12)
promo: turn on TikTok's "Your brand" disclosure
